note_data_splits: These train/val/test.jsonl files were generated by the backend CLI's synthetic-only dataset builder (354 synthetic examples). The LoRA model (iakshayrathee/contractiq-lora-llama3) was actually trained in notebooks/contractiq_lora_finetune.ipynb on the CUAD dataset directly: 6702 converted examples from 510 contracts, split 80/10/10 into 5361 train / 670 val / 671 test.
note: The production fine-tuned model is the HuggingFace LoRA adapter above, trained on CUAD data via Google Colab. Use LLM_PROVIDER=local_lora to enable it. The CLI dataset builder (backend/app/finetuning/dataset_builder.py) generates the synthetic-only splits stored in this directory.
